contributorProof.contributorUse: exactly one matmul_offsets_0061 lookup, two raw loads, and one matmul_fma_0061 call per iteration
contributorProof.noDrop: There is no floating predicate, early continue, finite-only branch, zero filter, or alternate accumulator update.
contributorProof.noReassociation: The source exposes one accumulator dependency chain and requests MTLMathModeSafe; no fast-math mode, reduction primitive, parallel partial sum, or independent accumulator exists.
contributorProof.noPretruncation: FLOAT32 operands and accumulator remain FLOAT32 through the sole fused site; BFLOAT16 inputs are widened by exact bit placement before that site.

specialValueProof.daz: A subnormal operand reaches the sole fma as its exact represented FLOAT32 value or, where the device applies DAZ, as same-sign zero; no source transform admits any third value.
specialValueProof.ftz: A subnormal fma result reaches the next accumulation/store exactly or, where the device applies FTZ, as same-sign zero; no source transform admits any third value.
specialValueProof.nan: NaN operands and invalid fused operations propagate through the sole safe-mode fma to a NaN class; raw bit store performs no finite substitution.
specialValueProof.infinity: Infinity operands retain IEEE fused-operation class behavior. For finite operands and accumulator, an infinity result can arise only from overflow of the fused mathematical result.
specialValueProof.signedZero: Raw loads and BFLOAT16 widening preserve input zero signs. The safe-mode fma determines the IEEE result sign, including cancellation, a DAZ-normalized zero product, and addition to the signed accumulator; the raw store preserves that result sign.
specialValueProof.finalNonemptyZeroSignFreedom: When the final nonempty contraction accumulator is exactly zero after the permitted site rules, the Model admits either published zero sign. The raw store publishes the device-selected fma zero bits and cannot substitute a nonzero value.
specialValueProof.finiteContributorPreservation: Every finite contributor participates in the ordered fma chain even when its product is zero, subnormal, overflows, or follows a prior non-finite accumulator.
